BiblicalUsage: Zorah is a town in Judah, the home of Manoah and of Samson. In Joshua 15:33, Zoreah, and Ashnah. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zorah reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
